method: Full text of every *Def.cfm under Afc*/Afo*/Acu* module dirs fetched via client_code_grep (whole-file multiline match), comments stripped (<!--- --->, /* */, //), CProperties rows simulated in order (ar++ = new row; later slot assignments under a different condition recorded as overrides). View-only = [9] has v and not e, OR row is only built inside an AMethod IS "v" condition. Type h (hidden) excluded. section = the divider heading the row renders under in AfcForm/ViewForm.cfm (cm+fb heading text, else presentation-group name from [15]).

modeKey.l: listing columns (AfcForm/ListForm.cfm: ListFindNoCase([9], AMethod), AMethod default l)
modeKey.v: View screen (AfcForm/ViewForm.cfm renders rows where [9] contains v)
modeKey.e: Edit/Add form (AfcForm/EditForm.cfm renders and saves rows where [9] contains e)
modeKey.r: NOT confirmed in the renderer: nothing in AfcForm/AfcControl/AfcStandard/AfcEngine/AfcRelated tests [9] for r literally; ListForm tests [9] against AMethod, so r is an AMethod value set by some caller. 148 rows carry r, 84 of them the Name/Title link column (type tl) -> most likely the Related-items / lookup listing mode (CMethods includes related).

groupKey.source: ePresentationTypeAr in AfcForm/ViewForm.cfm and EditForm.cfm; [15] picks the divider heading; cm rows with [6]=fb start a new divider titled with [4]

cmPanelSemantics: type cm: if [6]=fb a new divider/tab heading is drawn with [4] as its title; if [5] is non-empty that include file is cfincluded at that point (the panel content). cm with fb and no include = a section heading whose fields follow; cm with include = a self-rendering panel (e.g. /AfoSiteAnalysis/CC/RecentViewersInclude.cfm).

Rows whose [9] is a variable were resolved by collecting string assignments to that variable in the same file (noted per item); about 70 rows, some unresolved (e.g. variables.BProperties[...][9], modeOrder* vars in Order screens)

AfoCommunity/CC/AwardsProfileQuestionDef.cfm builds CProperties twice (two branches); rows from both are included
Brace/condition tracking is heuristic (regex state machine); condition text in notes may be truncated or mis-nested in unusual files
